name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-image-ark
description: Volcengine Ark (Seedream) image-generation provider for the DeepSeek Harness image seam (ctx.image) — posts prompts to the Ark /images/generations endpoint over Bearer ARK-key auth with optional reference-image conditioning and layer decomposition, downloads the answered image URLs into raw bytes, maps decomposed layers onto the seam's layer vocabulary, reads the ARK key from a named environment variable at call time, and surfaces endpoint failures as typed IMAGE_PROVIDER_FAILED errors with no local fallback
